title: Cambridge IGCSE First Language English 0990/0500 — Paper 2 Directed Writing and Composition

authority.sitting: 0990/21 May/June 2024 — Cambridge IGCSE (9–1) First Language English, Maximum Mark 80
authority.why_this_source: The board's own published mark scheme for a real series, in the code the student sits. Supersedes the 0500 syllabus citation this file carried on 2026-08-18 — see the P1 source for why that first search wrongly reported no mark schemes on disk.
authority.0990_vs_0500: MEASURED (2026-08-18): the 0500 and 0990 June 2024 Paper 2 mark schemes state identical splits — 25 writing, 15 reading, 16 content and structure, 24 style and accuracy.

questions.why_no_marks_quote: Section A is stated as writing (25) plus reading (15); the mark scheme never prints 40.

components.label: writing
components.note: ⚠️ All five writing AOs. W5 (spelling, punctuation and grammar) is ONE of the five. Until v7.20.529 these sat in spag_marks, so the router preamble announced 'SPaG=25' — telling Sophia a quarter of the paper is technical accuracy.
components.quote: This question tests the following writing assessment objectives (25 marks)

questions.why_no_marks_quote: Composition is marked on two tables — 16 for content and structure, 24 for style and accuracy. The 40 is their sum; the AO line quotes it too but the split is what the marking actually uses.
questions.quote: The question tests the following writing objectives (40 marks)
questions.note: ⭐ NOT CURRENTLY IN THE SPEC: language-paper-specs.json records Section B as a flat 40 with no component split. The mark scheme marks it as two separate table scores. Worth carrying into the spec + the topic template so a student sees where the 40 comes from.

components.label: content_and_structure
components.quote: Use Table A to give a mark out of 16 for content and structure

components.label: style_and_accuracy
components.note: W5 (SPaG) lives INSIDE this 24 alongside vocabulary, sentence structure and register — it is not a standalone SPaG allocation.
components.quote: give a mark out of 24 for style and accuracy

protocols_note: Cambridge has NO protocol-a-assessment.md — served through protocols/shared/templates/topics/cambridge-igcse-language-p2.md, gated separately by bin/cambridge-topics-gate.php against the same 80-mark spec.
